The surface maps are 1K and the skies are 2K. The three prop FBXs keep their original UVs. Blender reduces the scanned stump for distant scenery and renders the fir from two directions for the tree line. The original downloads live locally under `SourceAssets/Downloads/PolyHaven/`. Rebuild these derivatives with `SourceAssets/Environments/prepare_props.py` in Blender 4.5.
